Consequently, declaring the traditional album format dead is premature, as these new digital avenues have not yet proven capable of fully replacing the struggling physical and digital formats that currently drive revenue.", "summary": "Music industry experts view app-based distribution as an emerging, not yet viable, replacement for the album."}, "17": {"original": "It is premature to predict the iPod's death, but even Steve Jobs cannot revive", "rephrased": "Although the iPod remains relevant for now, its decline is inevitable because no single device or manufacturer can successfully revive the struggling music industry's primary distribution model. This reality forces the sector to urgently search for a new technological stepping stone to achieve future growth, as the current path is unsustainable.", "summary": "The iPod's decline is irreversible, compelling the music industry to find a new growth strategy."}}
